chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), mentioning his virtue and admonishing the people.

key_terms.يَعِظ: To admonish or give moral advice

ai.seo_question: What is the main theme of Imam Ali's speech regarding the virtue of the Ahl al-Bayt in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This header from Sharif al-Radi’s *Nahj al-Balagha* frames the subsequent discourse as a dual-purpose address, highlighting the unique spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt while delivering practical moral guidance to the broader community. In Shia scholarship, this juxtaposition underscores the concept that the Household of the Prophet serves not only as the source of divine knowledge but also as the exemplars of ethical conduct for all Muslims.
